title: Outbound Copy Humanizer
one_line: Rewrite outbound copy so it reads like a person wrote it, removing the tells that mark a message as generated.
description: Rewrite outbound copy so it reads like a person wrote it, removing the tells that mark a message as generated. Use when copy sounds robotic, when a draft is full of hedges and stock phrases, or when someone wants their outreach to sound like them.
paragraph: Generated outbound has a recognizable surface: tripled adjectives, a hedge before every claim, transitions nobody says out loud, and a closing sentence that restates the email. This skill strips those patterns and rebuilds the sentence rhythm against the sender's own writing, without flattening the message into slang.
requirements_summary: Needs no account, key or paid service: it works from the files, exports and answers you give it.
